missions.title: The Royal Sisters
missions.desc: Kyrie, Atherea and Ranrea go after the Sky Rebellion - to bring Kyrie's mother home.

lines.t: Kyrie, what's with the outfit?
My mom's old battle uniform. The attack on SR happens today.
A plan? Whyyy... that sounds like a lot of trabajar. ...Ada.
They took my mom. It's a death plan - if you don't want to come, leave now.
Same as always, sis. We're with you.

steps.obj: Follow Ranrea's nose to the SR hideout

missions.title: The Bait Hideout
missions.desc: SR sends Persephone - in Lexy's body - to say hi. Then Logan.

lines.t: Kyrie, leave now. Three Royals is exactly what SR wants.
Lexy, we're friends. Come back to SP.
She killed my only friend, Ava. LET ME KILL HER! ...Kyrie! It's night-night time!
Girls! Royal Formation 1!

escape_lines.t: Now now, three on one isn't very fair, is it?
Ranrea's down... That's it. ZACK, GET OVER HERE!!!

lines.t: A light purple flash. One kick for Persephone, one punch for Logan.
You tried attacking my girl.
Who are you really, Zack?
I'm... a demon. A lady named Technica tried to save us from the gas - her and a Skylander named Sintrie.
Sintrie?! ...Max from SP. He killed countless Royals.
Logan and Persephone vanish through a portal. It was a bait hideout all along.
Then the earth moves - and a huge moon rises over a Government facility.
That's F3. Kyle's there. Kyrie - I'm coming with you.

missions.title: Meanwhile, at the Keepers' Palace
missions.desc: Duo's Keepers - Chase, Mimicry, the Seedling King, the Tree Demon and the old Fox King. And a visitor with a sleeping giant.

lines.t: Duo needs a month to break out of that church. He'll need our help.
Duo knows I can take the Xeno Warriors myself. Haha!
Is that so? I don't need my crown to take you down.
Not at the Palace! Someone'll sense your karma!
Mid-fight, Chase cuts the Seedling King down. A seed drops into his hand.
If I ever see you fighting another Keeper again... you're dead.
Xylan the Warlord has been captured. He works for me now.
...A human the devil himself feared.
Xylan, reveal your presence! ...Uh. Father? He won't listen to me.
HAHAHA! You can't make him move, can you?!
Senju. Come with me. I'll tell you Duo's new plans.
